title: Sparkly television
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFE066'>
    <path d='M14 20 L16 26 L22 28 L16 30 L14 36 L12 30 L6 28 L12 26 Z'/>
    <path d='M84 16 L85.5 21 L90 22.5 L85.5 24 L84 29 L82.5 24 L78 22.5 L82.5 21 Z'/>
    <path d='M78 72 L79.5 77 L84 78.5 L79.5 80 L78 85 L76.5 80 L72 78.5 L76.5 77 Z'/>
    <path d='M18 68 L19.5 73 L24 74.5 L19.5 76 L18 81 L16.5 76 L12 74.5 L16.5 73 Z'/>
    <path d='M50 8 L51.5 13 L56 14.5 L51.5 16 L50 21 L48.5 16 L44 14.5 L48.5 13 Z' fill='#FFB3E6'/>
    <path d='M90 48 L91 52 L95 53 L91 54 L90 58 L89 54 L85 53 L89 52 Z' fill='#FFB3E6'/>
    <path d='M8 48 L9 52 L13 53 L9 54 L8 58 L7 54 L3 53 L7 52 Z' fill='#FFB3E6'/>
  </g>

  <!-- TV body -->
  <rect x='22' y='28' width='56' height='42' rx='7' fill='#E8574A'/>
  <!-- body lighter edge -->
  <rect x='22' y='28' width='56' height='42' rx='7' fill='none' stroke='#FF8A7A' stroke-width='2.5'/>

  <!-- screen bezel -->
  <rect x='28' y='33' width='44' height='30' rx='4' fill='#3D5A80'/>
  <!-- screen -->
  <rect x='31' y='36' width='38' height='24' rx='3' fill='#5BC0EB'/>
  <!-- screen shine -->
  <path d='M34 39 L46 39 L34 52 Z' fill='#9BE3FF' opacity='0.7'/>
  <rect x='34' y='54' width='18' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#9BE3FF' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- knobs -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='66' r='3' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='66' r='1.2' fill='#B8860B'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='66' r='3' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='66' r='1.2' fill='#B8860B'/>

  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='70' width='5' height='10' rx='2' fill='#C4443A'/>
  <rect x='65' y='70' width='5' height='10' rx='2' fill='#C4443A'/>

  <!-- antenna -->
  <line x1='50' y1='28' x2='42' y2='14' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='28' x2='58' y2='14' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='14' r='3' fill='#FFB3E6'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='14' r='3' fill='#FFB3E6'/>

  <!-- cute face on screen -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='46' r='2.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='46' r='2.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <path d='M44 52 Q50 57 56 52' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
